candidate.blueprint_locator: Appendix A, printed p. 26, Safety and Infection Prevention and Control → Standard Precautions/Transmission-Based Precautions/Surgical Asepsis: apply infection-prevention principles including appropriate PPE and hand hygiene.
candidate.blueprint_topic: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control — PPE removal and hand hygiene
candidate.educational_objective: Doff contaminated gown and gloves before leaving the patient-care area, avoid contaminating skin or clothing during removal, discard appropriately, and perform hand hygiene afterward.

options.A: Keep the gown and gloves on until after leaving the patient-care area so contaminated surfaces are handled only in the hallway.
options.B: Remove and discard the PPE before leaving the patient-care area, use a technique that avoids contaminating skin or clothing, and perform hand hygiene after removal.
options.C: After removing the gloves, handle the contaminated front of the gown freely because bare hands are no longer at risk from the gown surface.
options.D: Wear the contaminated gown and gloves to the nurses' station and remove them after documentation is complete.

candidate.rationale: CDC Core Infection Prevention and Control Practices state that PPE other than respirators should be removed and discarded upon completion of the task before leaving the patient's room or care area, and personnel must be trained to remove and dispose of PPE in a manner that protects themselves and others. CDC Isolation Precautions further directs prevention of skin and clothing contamination during PPE removal, and hand hygiene is performed after glove/PPE removal. Carrying contaminated gown or gloves into common areas or touching contaminated gown surfaces unnecessarily increases self- and environmental-contamination risk.
candidate.source_claim_supported: CDC directs removal/disposal of non-respirator PPE before leaving the patient room/care area, removal in a manner that protects personnel/patients/others and prevents skin/clothing contamination, plus hand hygiene after glove/PPE removal.
